component.name: CIBO Calculator
CIBO Hesap Makinesi
component.summary: Modern, customizable desktop calculator and unit converter with 30+ themes
30+ temaya sahip modern, kişiselleştirilebilir masaüstü hesap makinesi ve dönüştürücü

description.p: CIBO Calculator is an advanced, aesthetically refined desktop calculator and unit conversion suite tailored for Linux and modern operating systems. Featuring full Wayland and X11 support with custom client-side window controls, CIBO brings together 18 dedicated calculation and converter modes under a unified, beautiful interface.

CIBO Hesap Makinesi, modern işletim sistemleri ve Linux için özel olarak geliştirilmiş, estetik ve işlevsel bir masaüstü hesap makinesi ve birim dönüştürücü paketidir. Özel pencere kontrolleri ile Wayland ve X11 uyumlu çalışan CIBO, 18 farklı mod ve zengin özellikleri tek bir zarif arayüzde bir araya getirir.

ul.li: 18 Calculation Modes: Standard, Scientific, Graphing (y = f(x)), Programmer (HEX/DEC/OCT/BIN and bitwise operations), Date Difference/Addition, and 13 comprehensive Unit Converters (Currency, Volume, Length, Weight, Temperature, Energy, Area, Speed, Time, Power, Data, Pressure, Angle).
30+ Handcrafted Themes with Light & Dark variations (over 60 visual styles including iOS, Windows 11, Cyberpunk, Neobrutalism, Claymorphism, Glassmorphism, Pixelart, AMOLED, and Matrix).
Independent Transparency & Frosted Glass (Acrylic) backdrop-filter controls for windows and buttons.
Full mathematical expression parser supporting multi-step formulas (e.g. 100*(10-7)/6), parentheses, and inline clipboard pasting.
Global persistent calculation history and multi-slot memory system (MC, MR, M+, M-, MS) with automatic memory-safe cleanup.
Fully customizable keyboard shortcuts with isolated left-Alt navigation.
Multilingual support with automatic system locale detection across 12 languages.
Simplified and streamlined Standard keypad layout (removed 1/x, x², and √x from standard mode and moved them to scientific mode).
Comprehensive multilingual app naming and desktop launcher localization.
Enhanced opaque button styling and independent acrylic transparency controls across all 30 themes.
Restored and optimized Memory (Bellek) subsystem with auto-cleaning memory drawer.
Wayland & KDE Plasma application identity and process branding.
